nina: Running into bundler errors using our JS SDK in Cloudflare Workers. esbuild fails: "could not resolve 'fs'". Any recommended edge pattern?

omar: Workers are browser-like. Top-level import `redwood-inference` pulls node-only transitive deps. We should expose an edge entrypoint.

nina: I tried `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/edge'` but it's not published yet. Workaround was adding esbuild flags `--platform=browser --external:fs --external:net` in wrangler build which is annoying for users.

jin: Short checklist we use: 1) provide `./edge` export in package.json pointing at an ESM file with no node deps; 2) emit `dist/edge.d.ts` that uses DOM types; 3) ensure retry code uses `globalThis.setTimeout` not `process.nextTick`.

omar: Also ensure package.json `exports` has a browser/edge condition so bundlers auto-pick it. Example: "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "types": "./dist/edge.d.ts" }.

nina: TypeScript trouble: our main d.ts references `NodeJS.ReadableStream`. Edge d.ts should use `ReadableStream` from lib.dom or avoid streaming signatures.

jin: Crypto note: Workers have `crypto.getRandomValues` not `randomBytes`. Offer a tiny helper that returns Uint8Array for edge builds.

build-bot: CI: branch `edge-shim` created. esbuild edge bundle ✅, unit tests: 48/50 (two node-only tests skipped).

omar: Docs: add a Workers quickstart + wrangler example and a short troubleshooting section (esbuild flags, ts lib dom).

nina: Will add starter repo and README snippet. Also good to gate verbose dev headers behind NODE_ENV so we don't hit worker header limits during local dev.

jin: Consider telemetry opt-in for `createEdgeClient` so we know adoption before we remove heavy deps from main entry.

nina: Thanks — will open PRs for the edge export + docs. For now I'll keep the wrangler hack in our customer repo. :thumbsup:
